Solano County Community Awareness~ SCCA | I take it personally when people want to take the water that ensures our local water quality | Facebook
I take it personally when people want to take the water that ensures our local water quality.
If we were to send more water from Northern California to LA... where would they put it?
L.A.'s reservoirs are full, and water is available.
I have no idea why they had no water at their hydrants.
It's NOT because they're not getting their allotment of water from Northern California.
My guess is that this is operator error or local mismanagement.
They have enough water, but the pumps and the piping that feed the hydrants could not keep up with the demand.
It could've been a result of power being cut to the pumps.
I know that happened in Berry Creek in 2020.
As to the water reserves, they have it, but they haven't had any rain since last May.
Imagine trying to clear the hills …
Good information to be sure and eliminates any arguments about the mismanagement of water.
I would suggest to everyone who has commented on this to find out what the Pacific Palisades city engineering standards are for its fire distribution system.
